def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    objs=comps(g)
    objs.sort(key=lambda o:(-len(o[1]),min(i for i,_ in o[1]),min(j for _,j in o[1])))
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]; P=set()
    for c,comp in objs:
        best=None
        for s in range(W+1):
            nxt=[(i,j+s) for i,j in comp]
            ok=all(j<W and res[i][j]==0 for i,j in nxt)
            if not ok: continue
            touch=any(b==W-1 or any(abs(a-pa)+abs(b-pb)==1 for pa,pb in P) for a,b in nxt)
            if touch: best=s; break
        s=best
        for i,j in comp:
            res[i][j+s]=c; P.add((i,j+s))
    return res

import json
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    objs=comps(g)
    objs.sort(key=lambda o:(-len(o[1]),-max(i for i,_ in o[1])))  # size desc, then bottom row desc
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]; P=set()
    for c,comp in objs:
        s=0
        while True:
            nxt=[(i,j+s+1) for i,j in comp]
            if any(b>=W or (res[i][b]!=0 and (i,b) not in P) for i,b in nxt): break
            s+=1
        assert s<=W, (c,comp)
        for i,j in comp:
            res[i][j+s]=c; P.add((i,j+s))
    return res
print('demo check:', all(solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'] for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']))
out=solve(G['Test input'])
for r in out: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
print(json.dumps(out))

def report(n):
    gi,go=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    ci=comps(gi); co=comps(go)
    print('=== demo',n,'input comps ===')
    for c,I_ in sorted(ci,key=lambda t:(t[0],sorted(t[1]))):
        rs=[min(i for i,_ in I_),max(i for i,_ in I_)]; cs=[min(j for _,j in I_),max(j for _,j in I_)]
        print(c,'h',rs[1]-rs[0]+1,'w',cs[1]-cs[0]+1,'cells',len(I_),'r',rs,'c',cs)
        if len(I_)<=6:
            grid=[[(x-i-min(i for i,_ in I_)) or 1] for i,j in []]
            g2=[[ 'O' if (i,j) in I_ else '.' for j in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)] for i in range(rs[0],rs[1]+1)]
            print('\n'.join(''.join(row) for row in g2))
    print('--- output ---')
    for c,O in co:
        rs=[min(i for i,_ in O),max(i for i,_ in O)]; cs=[min(j for _,j in O),max(j for _,j in O)]
        print(c,'cells',len(O),'r',rs,'c',cs)
